title: The Pawn Defends
setup: Your a7-pawn is blocked by the rook on a8, and your own rook is free to swing along the first rank.
hint: Which square beside the blockading rook is already guarded by the passed pawn itself?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rb8+}} is check and the rook is untouchable, because the a7-pawn guards b8. {{Rxb8}} runs into {{axb8=Q+}}, promoting with check and coming out a queen for a rook. Stepping aside with Kh7 instead just loses the rook to Rxa8.
